privacy: Your workbook stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
invalid: Choose a readable ODS workbook. The file may be damaged or contain invalid cell data.
protected: Encrypted ODS files cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted copy and try again.
unsupported: This workbook contains data that cannot be represented in XLSX, or uses an unsupported OpenDocument feature. Save an Excel-compatible copy in your spreadsheet application.
resource: This workbook needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
empty: This worksheet has no stored cell data.
previewNote: This window shows up to 20 rows and 8 columns. The download includes all imported worksheets and cells.
invalidAddress: Enter a cell address within this worksheet’s used range, such as A1.
missingCaches: Some formulas have no saved result. Their cells remain blank in the XLSX file; formula expressions are not exported.
preserved: Worksheet names and order, hidden worksheets, text, numbers, booleans, dates, saved formula results, and merged cells are included.
limitations: Formulas become their saved values; expressions are not retained or recalculated. Styles, charts, images, comments, links, macros, and workbook settings are not preserved. Check the output before relying on it.
previewLimits: Dates use a standard date/time format; explicit time zones are normalized to UTC. Durations remain numbers of days, and percentages use a basic percentage format. Currency values retain their number, without the currency label or original formatting.
